```{r}
my_breakfast <- c("bułka","pomidor","szynka","ser")
my_lunch <- c("ziemniaki","kotlet schabowy","mizeria")
meals <- list(my_breakfast, my_lunch)
dinner <- c("3 big mac`i", "frytki", "cola")
meals$dinner <- dinner
```

```{r}
names(meals)[2] <- 5
meals[["5"]]
```


```{r}

```

```{r}
pozycje <- lapply(meals, length)
```
